# Proposed SCI-POINT v0.1 r0.2 scientific-owner disposition

## Proposed disposition

**Conditionally accept SCI-POINT v0.1 document revision r0.2 as the targeted
Stage B repair of the accepted r0.1 architecture.**

The accepted scope is the generic scientific contract only. The revision
adopts the exact SCI-VAL four-axis types; the stage-specific producer lifecycle
and eight logical records; fit-component versus source-associated amplitude;
two independently requested derived diagnostics; role-state atomicity;
fixed-branch, full-procedure, parent, and empirical response/bias separation;
conditional displacement covariance; repaired PRED-001; new PRED-032; distinct
unavailable states; canonical tokens; POINT-facing parent boundary roles; and
source/build closure.

## Conditions retained

- No numerical POINT route is approved.
- `POINT-COMPATIBILITY-METHOD v0.1`, `POINT-FORMAL-ERROR-METHOD v0.1`, and
  `POINT-FULL-MAP-RMS-METHOD v0.1` remain separately unavailable pending
  content-bound owner approval.
- The four named-use profiles remain unregistered and unevaluable drafts.
- Exact numerical route boundary instances remain unavailable.
- Fixed-branch response, full-procedure response, and observational
  bias/accuracy remain separately unavailable under their distinct release
  conditions.
- No implementation, representation, response, covariance, uncertainty,
  validation, accuracy, performance, readiness, production, authorization, or
  Unity claim is accepted.

## Owner actions required for any later numerical or production claim

1. Approve the three content-bound method records independently.
2. Approve exact numerical parent-route boundary instances.
3. Review and register each draft named-use profile with its own policy owner.
4. Separately authorize any fixed-branch response, full-procedure response, or
   empirical observational bias/accuracy product sought.

Acceptance of this disposition would approve only the r0.2 contract text and
closure record; it would not approve any later method, route, profile, or
implementation by implication.
